_comment: research/lyt/ratified-literals.json -- LYT relations-first amendment, dispatch C4's RATCHET form (ledger rows 2396/2445). AUTHORED, commissioner-owned, the SAME posture facts.residue.json already takes -- NOT auto-generated from a fresh scan of the encodings. Reconciles ruling 2396 ('px literals... banned from encodings') with ruling 2445 (a QUALIFIED zero is ratified, not silently tolerated): every entry below is one of the ~59 px/ch literal sites dispatch C3's own encoding rewrite disclosedly left behind (its own report, .claude/dispatch-reports/lyt-relations-c3-rewrite.md §7, enumerates the SAME sites by category -- boardRail/I_board/A_board's own cold-boot-absent or never-probed facts, the settings pack-rows six item widths and search-ceiling (text-width-of has zero facts coverage), timelineStrip/settingsSubstrip/otherColorDebug (no facts entry), the three un-pitched ANALYSIS TABS columns plus the T wrapper and CP-analysis's own sum-of operands (the R5 residual item -- no descendant-reference primitive exists yet), the side column's own 345px width floor and 60ch cap component, the root split's own trivial 0px floor, previewBoard's landscape figure, and portrait's own mainContentRow/tree floors). Values were independently re-verified against the real committed encodings via research/lyt/tools/dump_ratifiable_sites.py (not hand-copied from the report) before this file was written. ADDING A SITE HERE REQUIRES FRESH COMMISSIONER RATIFICATION -- this is not a file a build script may append to; a new candidate surfaces via dump_ratifiable_sites.py, is reviewed against the SAME standard C3's own report applied (a genuine facts-substrate or grammar absence, not an oversight), and is added by hand, one entry at a time, with its own basis stated. KEYING: (file, site_id, construct, unit) -- see relations.RatifiedManifest's own docstring for the full scheme (widget id for a leaf; tag:<TAG> for a tagged Exclusive; a content-signature hash, stored alongside as content_signature, for an untagged Split/Exclusive) and why none of the three is ever a file:line or a sibling/child ordinal position. License: Public Domain (The Unlicense), matching research/lyt/__init__.py's license line and the umbrella's ADR-0006 per-file convention.
